div.div: أَزْفَلَةٌ A company, or collection, (S, K, TA,) of men, and of camels: (TA:) and ↓ أَزْفَلَى is like أَجْفَلَى, (S,) syn. therewith, (K,) signifying a collection, or an assemblage, of any things. (TA.) One says, جَاؤُوا بِأَزْفَلَتِهِمْ (Fr, S, TA) and بِأَجْفَلَتِهِمْ (Fr, TA) They came with their company. (Fr, S, TA.) And جَآؤُوا أَزْفَلَةً and أَجْفَلَةً They came in a company. (Fr, S and K * in art. جفل.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
